Three proofs before one brush stroke

Proof 01 · Sketch

Concept sketch on paper

Three style directions drawn to your wall's dimensions. You pick one before we scale it up.

Proof 02 · Color

Color strip and material swatches

Every paint chip laid out beside a photo of your wall. You sign off on the palette before we mix.

Proof 03 · Approved

To-scale proof on your wall photo

The mural placed on a photograph of the actual surface, with dimensions and a dated schedule. If the finished wall doesn't match, we repaint the difference.

You approve a to-scale proof before paint. If the wall doesn't match the proof, we repaint the difference.

What we paint

  • Interior murals

    Priced by the square foot, shown as a to-scale proof on a photo of your wall.

    Price it

  • Exterior murals

    Brick and stucco walls tested for moisture, primed, painted and sealed against sun and tags.

    Price it

  • Business and storefront murals

    A dated schedule around your opening, with proof approval before a single brush comes out.

    Price it

  • Restaurant and cafe murals

    Low-odor paint, night or morning sessions, and a wipeable clear coat for busy dining rooms.

    Price it

  • Nursery and kids' room murals

    Original characters drawn for your family, painted with low-odor paint weeks before the baby arrives.

    Price it

  • Faux finishes

    Marble, plaster and wood-grain looks matched to a sample board you sign off first.

    Price it

  • Trompe l'oeil

    Painted windows, arches and shelves measured to your room so the depth reads right.

    Price it

  • Mural restoration

    Faded or tagged murals cleaned, color-matched from a swatch test and resealed.

    Price it

  • Design consultations

    Wall measured, three style directions, one priced proof you can keep even if you stop there.

    Price it
